text:
mika: Heads-up — I want to run a quick canary for the attn-fuse + paged combo on longseq workloads. Goal: catch KV-cache cliffs or perf regressions before the full suite. Need a 2h GPU slot and someone to watch profiling. @ben @ryan? :wave:

ben: I can grab 2–4pm PT on dedicated-west. Which branch/sha should I pull?

ryan: Use branch `attn-fuse/v3` (PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4832). Quick canary command:
```
./bench_runner --model=gpt-small --seq-lens=512,2048 --batch=1 --profile=nvprof --branch=attn-fuse/v3 --runs=3
```
Add `--prefetch=2` if mem prefetching is enabled for that build.

alina: :eyes: I can take nvprof traces and produce flamegraphs. If you get traces, drop them in /tmp/bench-traces/ and ping me.

luis: One ask — tag the experiment metadata with `bench-suite:longseq` and `exp-owner:mika`. If we see >5% regression on p95, we'll label the PR `bench/regress-longseq` and block rollout.

ops-bot: GPU pool "dedicated-west" reserved: job 2248123456-1 (2xA100) — reserved by ben for 2h starting now.

mika: Starting canary now (job id 2248123456-1). I'll paste a short summary when done.

mika: Canary finished — quick numbers below (median of 3 runs):
```
Model     seq   p50(ms)  p95(ms)  tokens/s
gpt-small 512   6.2      12.3     430
gpt-small 2048  28.1     46.2     380   # ~8% drop vs baseline
```

alina: Thanks — 2048 p95 looks ~8% worse. I'll upload nvprof and flamegraphs to the trace dir and look for kernel tail and shared-memory stalls.

ryan: I'll bisect commits in attn-fuse/v3. If the kernel fuse defaults cause regressions I'll flip the runtime toggle `--attn-fuse=off` and run again. If >5% we'll revert the fused-kernel default.

ben: Okay — I'll queue a full sweep tomorrow across models/batches. Great catch. :thumbsup:

mika: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will file a follow-up issue with the flamegraphs and next steps.
